sonnet.problem: The itinerary stretch (verses 10-15) is told item by item, naming Oboth, Iye-abarim and the Valley of Zered. It also takes two story cards (1 and 2) instead of one summary card.
sonnet.rule: He says in a few words what it covers and doesn't go item by item.

sonnet.problem: The travel list in verses 18-20 is told item by item (Mattanah, Nahaliel, Bamoth, Pisgah) instead of summed up in a few words.
sonnet.rule: He says in a few words what it covers and doesn't go item by item.

sonnet.problem: This card tells Israel capturing and occupying the Amorite cities right after the battle. Conquest is violence, and the card adds a joke ("picking out CURTAINS").
sonnet.rule: A card that tells death, violence, abuse, serious sin or the body's private matters has no joke.

sonnet.problem: The question calls them "Moab's daughters," but verse 29 says "his daughters," where "he" is Chemosh. The card names the owner differently than the text does.
sonnet.rule: Call things what the text calls them.

sonnet.problem: The right answer "Sihon" was already the right answer on card 11 ("Sihon king of the Amorites"). An answer shown on an earlier card is reused.
sonnet.rule: An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.
